parameters.description:
`msg-to-resend-email` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your Resend email destination — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through a native gateway transformation that posts straight to your own Resend email destinations — free, and driven entirely by the credentials you have stored. Paid variants ($0.001 / message) deliver to additional Resend email destinations bound per enrollment.

Resend accounts are free to create. Once signed up, authenticate the domain you'll send from under Domains (resend.com/domains) in your dashboard, and generate an API key with at least "Sending" permission under API Keys (resend.com/api-keys) — set that key as RESEND_EMAIL_APIKEY. Set RESEND_FROM_EMAIL to an address on your authenticated domain, and RESEND_TO_EMAIL to the recipient's address.
parameters.gateway_body_template_plus: {"from":"${ customer_secrets.{{ params.from_email_secret }} }","to":["${ customer_secrets.{{ params.to_email_secret }} }"],"subject":{* _escape_json(_body.title or "") *},"text":{* _escape_json(_body.body or "") *}}
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment Resend destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to Resend emails API
parameters.summary: Send a notification to your own Resend email destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

apikey_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Resend Email apikey

from_email_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's RESEND_FROM_EMAIL value (same format as RESEND_FROM_EMAIL)

to_email_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's RESEND_TO_EMAIL value (same format as RESEND_TO_EMAIL)
